title: EXP-022 — Static No-Colon Recovery Across Ordinary Close/Reopen
objective: Create one new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_StaticNoColonLab01`, add one Static component named `FX_StaticNoColonStatic01`, and before the property under test establish a visible setup baseline by assigning Caption `Static No Colon Test` and recording the component's Name, Caption, No Colon, and the comparison properties exposed by the verified component workflow. Require the pre-test No Colon value to be False; otherwise stop as blocked rather than changing additional properties to manufacture a transition. Then change only No Colon from False to True, perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save to clean state, close the target exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control, reopen it exactly once through Designer Form-menu recent forms in the same Designer/client context, and verify that No Colon=True, Caption and comparison properties are unchanged, and the rendered Static display reflects the no-colon state. Treat this only as UI-level recovery across the tested weak close-only boundary; make no database-durability, cache-eviction, serialization, or internal-instance claim.

in_scope: Read EXP-003-R2, EXP-008-R2, EXP-019-R2, EXP-021, recipes/forms/create-basic-form.md, recipes/components/add-component-from-toolbox.md, and recipes/components/configure-basic-component.md before mutation

Record rendered Static text only as optional corroborating evidence if actually visible; if it is not visible, leave rendered state unresolved without blocking this pre-reopen step

Read-only final action-count and repository-confinement audit limited to this experiment record and `evidence/EXP-022/`

acceptance_checks.description: Before target mutation, visibly prove a usable live Mongoose workflow and Editing Scope=User, then use the supported Select Form Name filter in case-insensitive mode with a visible positive control to prove `FX_StaticNoColonLab01` has zero matching rows. If one pre-mutation session establishment is needed, disclose it and repeat these guards afterward. Evidence must distinguish the positive-control hit from the target-zero result.

Create exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_StaticNoColonLab01` through the verified fresh-dialog/basic-form path with Save Template unchecked, and capture its loaded clean state plus visible Name/ScopeType/ScopeName identity.

Perform one Static creation operation, name it `FX_StaticNoColonStatic01`, assign Caption exactly `Static No Colon Test` as pre-test setup, and then capture the pre-No-Colon baseline before the tested mutation. The baseline must prove component Name, Caption exactly `Static No Colon Test`, No Colon=False, and the other comparison properties exposed by the verified component workflow using exact property-grid/accessibility evidence. If canvas text actually renders, record it separately as optional corroborating evidence; otherwise leave rendered state unresolved without blocking AC-3. If No Colon is not False, stop blocked.

After AC-3, change only No Colon from False to True. Capture exact No Colon=True, unchanged Caption and comparison properties, and the expected dirty Designer state. Record canvas text separately as optional corroborating evidence only if actually visible; absence of pre-reopen rendering does not block AC-4 and leaves rendered state unresolved. Label rendered-visible evidence separately from exact property-grid/accessibility-derived values. AC-8 remains the decisive post-reopen rendered checkpoint.

Perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save after the No Colon edit and prove the Designer returns clean while `FX_StaticNoColonStatic01` remains present with No Colon=True, Caption exactly `Static No Colon Test`, and every recorded post-baseline comparison property unchanged.

Close `FX_StaticNoColonLab01` exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control and visibly prove the target tab is closed with no unsaved-change or unexpected prompt. Record that no explicit unload, Regenerate, preference change, client replacement, or post-mutation session-establishment action occurred.
Reopen the target exactly once through Designer Form-menu recent forms in the same Designer/client context and visibly verify matching User-scoped Form identity by Name + ScopeType + ScopeName.

After reopen, verify `FX_StaticNoColonStatic01` is present with No Colon=True, Caption exactly `Static No Colon Test`, and every recorded non-No-Colon comparison property equal to the AC-3 baseline. Capture rendered Static text as corroborating display evidence that the no-colon state is still reflected, without inferring internal instance identity or complete component cardinality.

Final read-only audit must reconcile exactly one ordinary Save, one target Form-tab close, one recent-forms reopen, no deliberate target-property mutation after AC-3 except No Colon, zero explicit unloads, zero Regenerates, zero preference changes, zero client replacements, and zero post-mutation authentication/session-establishment actions. Repository changes must be confined to the EXP-022 record and `evidence/EXP-022/`; any recovery-obstructed or session-expired inventory read is invalid evidence rather than grounds for another recovery attempt.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261006-100540-dxLq. Rationale: EXP-021 established one accepted observation for a Static component across the weak ordinary close/reopen boundary, while EXP-021-R2 was blocked by preflight/environment issues and must not be worked around by simply retrying that replay. The smallest independent next learning step is therefore a different Static-component metadata property already exposed by the verified component workflow: No Colon. This stays within the proven classic BuildFromScratch + Static-component lane, uses the replay-verified fresh-dialog/wizard selection and verified component procedures, and asks only whether one deliberate No Colon change is recovered after one ordinary Save, one Form-tab close, and one recent-forms reopen. It does not depend on any blocked variable, FormSync, Button-Caption, or Static-Caption replay result.
